title: Cuba from 1959: the revolution, the literacy campaign and the Cold War
goal: Tell what happened after 1959, using conditions without si (de + infinitive and the gerund).
grammar: conditions without si using de + infinitive or the gerund

items: I can state a condition without *si*, with *de* + infinitive or the gerund.
I can say what the literacy campaign of 1961 was and who took part in it.
I can use the new words for literacy, peasants and the embargo.
